name: Pit Fiend

Traits.name: Scorched Iron Plate
Traits.text: At the end of each of the fiend's turns, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the fiend takes 13 (3d8) Fire damage.
Traits.expresses: a body of scorched iron plate and hook-ended chains

Traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
Traits.text: If the fiend fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Traits.name: Diabolical Restoration
Traits.text: If the fiend dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

Traits.name: Fear Aura
Traits.text: The fiend emanates an aura in a 20-foot Emanation while it doesn't have the Incapacitated condition. *Wisdom Saving Throw*: DC 21, any enemy that starts its turn in the aura. *Failure:*  The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. *Success:*  The target is immune to this pit fiend's aura for 24 hours.

Traits.name: Magic Resistance
Traits.text: The fiend has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The fiend makes four attacks, using Bite or Devilish Claw in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast *Bestow Curse*.

Actions.name: Bite
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 10 ft. 18 (3d6 + 8) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must make the following saving throw. *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 21. *Failure:*  The target has the Poisoned condition. While Poisoned, the target can't regain Hit Points and takes 21 (6d6) Poison damage at the start of each of its turns, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

Actions.name: Devilish Claw
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 10 ft. 26 (4d8 + 8) Necrotic damage.

Actions.name: Spellcasting
Actions.text:
The fiend casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):

- **At Will:** *Bestow Curse*, *Hold Person*, *Fear*
- **1/Day Each:** *Wall of Fire* (level 5 version)

Actions.name: Hellfire Spellcasting (Recharge 4-6)
Actions.text: The fiend casts *Fireball* (level 5 version) twice, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 21). It can replace one *Fireball* with *Hold Monster* (level 7 version) or *Wall of Fire*.

lore: Forged in the deepest pits from the broken promises of hell's own legions, this fiend stalks battlefields to harvest the sworn words of dying knights, hoarding their vows as the only currency its masters will accept.
